items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Vito (Musso) did a hell of a solo on that thing.

ctx.x: And they made a thing called "Jam --" some kind of jam. Vito (Musso) did a hell of a solo on that thing. Krupa did it. And we had that arrangement.
Did you have any idea, thoughts, about why Benny's band made it so big playing some of the music that Fletcher and Chick Webb had done and they didn't make it?
